text: **[Paper section: “Diffusive Drift due to Ongoing Neural Noise”]** [Main article, pp. 2–3](../papers/burak-fiete-2012-persistent-activity.pdf#page=2). This chapter intersperses the supporting derivation with the paper’s diffusion result; the next chapter examines its simulation tests and long-delay implications.

**[Paper]** [A network can keep firing after a stimulus disappears and still lose the value that the stimulus supplied.]{.key-statement} Burak and Fiete study this distinction in a network whose stable activity patterns form a continuous set. **[Paper: random and systematic drift]** Noise can cause both random wandering and a systematic tendency to move in one direction.
